Q1.note: reverse-polarity protection of the cell (review H6): drain on the cell +, source on VBAT, gate on GND. Correct cell: body diode, then the channel (Vgs = -VBAT) conducts; reversed cell: off. RDS(on) 85 mohm at Vgs -2.5 V (60 at -4.5): about 60 mV at the 0.7 A boost peak. Charging (21 mA) flows source -> drain through the on channel. JLC basic part. SOT-23 1 G 2 S 3 D

U33.note: DOCK_XOR = DOCK_N XOR MOT_FWD = DOCKED XOR DIR_REVERSE (DOCK_N is active low, MOT_FWD high = forward): docked+forward and undocked+reverse allowed, undocked+forward and docked+reverse (H15) blocked; reset default MOT_FWD high (R16) = forward = blocked when undocked; JLC stock 3001 (review C2)

U36.note: PERM_L = LATCH_Q AND SUP_PERMIT AND MCU_EN (review M1: CLAUDE.md rule motor only with MCU enable AND watchdog in hardware); 74AUP1G11 pinout 1 A 2 GND 3 B 4 Y 5 VCC 6 C (LCSC symbol); the SC-70-6 74AUP1G11GW has JLC stock 3, this DFN-6 1.0 x 1.45 clone has 9000
